Every word is transcribed on device. Links in the thread.

note_tweet.text:
A cloud API call doesn’t need your contacts’ names.

Cue, @AgrawalHridaya’s smart clipboard for Mac, strips them out before anything leaves your machine. Redact runs on the device and swaps names, phone numbers and addresses for placeholders, so the cloud model sees [GIVEN_NAME_1], not Maya.

The paste still uses your real text, and if Redact can’t run, Cue does a plain paste instead of sending anything unredacted.

Very cool.

https://t.co/OvlxaSiY9x
